overview.description: The Teucrium Corn Fund (CORN) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Teucrium Corn Fund Benchmark index. The fund tracks an index of corn futures contracts. It reflects the performance of corn by holding Chicago Board of Trade corn futures contracts with three different expiration dates. CORN was launched on Jun 9, 2010 and is issued by Teucrium.
